title.zh: 在新怡诗夏省Gapan市镇Kapalangan设立中学，名称为Kapalangan国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in Kapalangan, Gapan, Nueva Ecija, to Be Known as the Kapalangan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in Kapalangan, Gapan, Nueva Ecija, to Be Known as the Kapalangan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Kapalangan, Gapan, Nueva Ecija được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Kapalangan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาใน Kapalangan, Gapan, Nueva Ecija ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Kapalangan
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Kapalangan, Gapan, Nueva Ecija dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Kapalangan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Kapalangan, Gapan, Nueva Ecija dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Kapalangan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8464_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports (DECS), a high school in Barangay Kapalangan, Gapan, Nueva Ecija, to be known as the Kapalangan National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
